/api/*.onProxyReq: function(proxyReq, req, res) { console.log('Proxying request:', req.url, 'Content-Type:', req.headers['content-type']); }
/api/*.onError: function(err, req, res) { console.error('Proxy error:', err); }
/api/*.bypass: function(req, res, proxyOptions) { if (req.headers['content-type'] && req.headers['content-type'].includes('multipart/form-data')) { console.log('Multipart form detected'); } }
